verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS code-review product publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions open-source code, a public repository, or a license. The materials cover a hosted, subscription-based service: a free trial, a free plan, flex capacity and SOC 2. Repo-level cubic.yaml configuration and community custom agents are user configuration, not the product's own source.
